subject: [PATCH v4 14/19] selftests/mm: run every supported collapse order by default

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged test to run every supported collapse order by default, rather than requiring the user to specify a specific order. The test also changes how it handles the -c option, which now pins one order and provides feedback on what is wrong instead of printing usage text. Additionally, the test now checks for valid ranges before using the -s and -c options, and drops the mTHP context if a different memory type is specified. This change aims to improve the efficiency and usability of the test by reducing the number of required invocations and providing more informative feedback.
